evidence.observation: Pressure 3.07 Torr, in line with the steady ~3.04 Torr held through the ramp.
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.329 Torr, about 0.05 Torr per 120 s, well beyond the ~0.02 Torr noise.
Argon flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by more gas going in.
Thermocouple at 750.0 °C on setpoint, and heater power steady at ~46%.
No O2 sensor is installed, so the atmosphere required for growth cannot be verified.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading or a helium leak check would show whether air is getting in (seal leak) or the pump line is blocked. Checking the pump-side pressure or valve position, or stepping the argon flow and watching how pressure responds, would also help separate the two.
